title: Choosing your first upgrades
target: How to choose between the upgrades in TCG Card Shop Simulator, given that the game names each one and separates them by pack tier.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: An idea of which pack tier sells best for you

steps.do: Upgrade the tier you actually sell rather than buying packs in general.
steps.because: pack supply upgrades are named per tier (BasicCardPackSupply)

steps.do: If shelves keep emptying, look at supply and earnings before anything decorative.
steps.because: earnings can be upgraded per pack and box tier (CommonPackEarningUp)

steps.do: Buy the customer upgrades when the shop feels quiet, not the ones with the biggest-looking name.
steps.because: there are upgrades for what customers spend, buying more and arriving sooner (CustomerSpawnTime)

steps.do: Leave the collector upgrades until you are actually selling the cards collectors want.
steps.because: collector rates are upgraded grade by grade (CustomerCollectorSpawnRate)

steps.do: Remember that boosters are a separate list from upgrades.
steps.because: booster effects are tracked apart from upgrades (EBoosterEffect)

commonMistakes: Buying an upgrade for a tier you hardly stock.
Spending on decoration while the shelves sit empty.
Treating a booster effect as though it were an upgrade.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
